text:
alex.p: quick sync — drafting a compact playbook for per-route structured-output validation and fallback across hosted / dedicated / private. want alignment on scope, launch criteria, and runtime behavior. TL;DR: opt-in for existing routes, recommended-on for new routes, strict enforcement only via org opt-in. canary rollout required.

maya.eng: perf concern — runtime validation on every request will add CPU and tail-latency. propose a route flag and sdk helpers so teams can opt-in per-route.

alex.p: agreed. design proposal: route flag `validate_structured_output_v2` (default false for existing routes). SDK exposes `validateResponse()` helper that can run sync or async + streaming hook.

sam.release: need concrete launch criteria in the PRD: perf p95 delta <120ms for enabled routes, canary telemetry shows <1% user-visible regressions, migration docs, SDK examples, QA sign-off, and a maintenance window.

rachel.qa: acceptance checklist draft:
- CI: schema linter and unit schema-conformance checks for any schema PRs
- E2E: golden prompt set — correctness regression <= 2%
- Fault injection: simulate streaming truncation and validator timeouts
- Observability: validation_failure events must include request_id, model_variant, seq_len, route, and fallback flag

ben.support: three enterprise prospects (finance, health, advertising) asked for strict enforcement + audit trail. they want org-level opt-in, immutable audit entries, and quick rollback steps.

maya.eng: edge cases we should document:
- streaming responses where validator detects malformed JSON mid-stream
- partial/truncated JSON emitted before generation stopped
- syntactically-valid JSON that fails semantic checks (e.g., wrong enum or missing nested id)
Proposal for streaming: if validator detects invalid JSON mid-stream, emit a structured error event and append a final fallback block prefixed with header `X-Redwood-Structured-Fallback: validation_failed`. SDK streaming helpers will surface a `validation_error` final event.

maya.eng: minimal JSON Schema prototype for discussion:
```
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": { "type": "string" },
    "params": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false }
  },
  "required": ["action"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

alex.p: rollout plan (staged):
1) publish validator library + docs as dev-preview
2) add route flag + SDK helpers in beta (default off for existing routes)
3) canary: 2% traffic x 48h -> 25% x 7d -> 100%
4) enterprise: add org-level strict enforcement option + audit logs for opt-in customers

rachel.qa: tests i'll add:
- unit: validator positive/negative matrix (edgecases + fuzz)
- integration: streaming + truncated-json injection harness
- regression: golden prompt correctness delta measurement pipeline

ben.support: migration doc items customers expect:
- how to opt-in per-route and per-org
- how to detect fallback via `X-Redwood-Structured-Fallback` header and SDK events
- sample server-side handler for `schema_validation_error` event payloads
- rollback steps and troubleshooting checklist

maya.eng: telemetry metrics to emit:
- validation_pass
- validation_fail
- validation_timeout
- fallback_used
capture dims: route, client_org, model_variant, sequence_length, and validator_version. trigger detailed capture (payload snippets, model logs) when fail_rate > 1% per route.

alex.p: decisions recorded for PRD: default validation_off for existing routes; recommend validation_on for new routes; strict_enforce is enterprise opt-in only; fallback behavior = raw/textual fallback + header `X-Redwood-Structured-Fallback` + structured event for replay; staged canary rollout required.

schema-bot: opened PR #482-draft: validator v0.3 (streaming hooks + header behavior). CI: basic schema linter + unit tests.

sam.release: ack — i'll reserve release window next Wed and run perf/load tests against the validator baseline. :thumbsup: 

alex.p: i'll update the PR with this checklist and assign owners. please comment if you see any missing acceptance criteria or edgecases. thanks!
